name: The singer's body
text: Carry the body hidden in the wig room to the artists' waiting room.

name: The phoenix crown
text: Take the phoenix crown from the interval bar back to the royal box.

name: The patron's ledger
text: Bring the ledger from the service stairwell to the shuttered office.

name: The gilded mask
text: Return the gilded mask from the orchestra room to its cabinet.

name: The vault keys
text: Carry the ring of keys from the back corridor to the dusty vault.

name: The last rehearsal
text: Dance in the ballet room, then take a bow in the orchestra pit.

name: The pilgrim's round
text: Light incense at the little shrine, then pray in the chapel.

name: The house's vermin
text: Destroy three of the house's monsters in one night.

name: Nerve of steel
text: Pass two of the house's tests in one night.
